label: Agent: Place Call
description: Place an outbound phone call with an ElevenLabs voice agent, from a Twilio, Exotel or SIP trunk number on the account. The agent holds the conversation on its own; wire the conversation id into Agent: Get Conversation for the transcript.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (agents and phone numbers live in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: agent
inputs.label: Agent
inputs.placeholder: Pick an agent, or paste its id

inputs.name: phoneNumber
inputs.label: From number
inputs.placeholder: Pick an imported number, or paste its id
inputs.description: The number the call comes from: one imported on the account (Agents > Phone Numbers), from Twilio, Exotel or a SIP trunk.

inputs.name: toNumber
inputs.label: To number
inputs.description: The number to call, E.164 format.

inputs.name: dynamicVariables
inputs.description: Values for the agent prompt's {{variables}} on this call, e.g. { "customer_name": "Ada" }.

inputs.name: firstMessage
inputs.label: First message
inputs.description: What the agent says first on this call, in place of its own first message. An empty text makes it wait for the other side to speak first. The agent must allow it: `agent.first_message` in Agent: Create's `allowOverrides`.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The system prompt for this call, in place of the agent's own. The agent must allow it: `agent.prompt.prompt` in Agent: Create's `allowOverrides`.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: The language for this call as an ISO code, like `fr`, in place of the agent's own. The agent must allow it: `agent.language` in Agent: Create's `allowOverrides`.

inputs.name: voice
inputs.label: Voice
inputs.placeholder: Pick a voice, or paste a voice id
inputs.description: The voice for this call, in place of the agent's own. The agent must allow it: `tts.voice_id` in Agent: Create's `allowOverrides`.

inputs.name: userId
inputs.label: User id
inputs.description: Your own id for the person called, kept on the conversation so you can find their calls later.

inputs.name: branchId
inputs.label: Branch
inputs.description: The id of the agent branch to use for this call.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: The environment whose variables this call uses. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, production.

inputs.name: clientData
inputs.label: More call settings
inputs.description: Any other setting for this call, written as the JSON ElevenLabs takes in `conversation_initiation_client_data`: more changes in `conversation_config_override` (each one the agent must allow), `starting_workflow_node_id`, `procedure_ids`, `custom_llm_extra_body`. The inputs above go on top of it: objects merge key by key, and where both set the same key, the input wins.

inputs.name: ringingTimeoutSecs
inputs.label: Ring for
inputs.description: How many seconds to ring before giving up, from 1 to 999; the number's provider may cut it shorter. Leave empty for ElevenLabs's default, 60.

inputs.name: recordCall
inputs.label: Record on Twilio
inputs.description: Turn on to have Twilio record the call; the recording is stored in your Twilio account. Twilio numbers only.

inputs.name: answeringMachineDetection
inputs.label: Detect answering machines
inputs.description: Twilio's own check for an answering machine. `enable` gives a verdict as soon as Twilio can tell a person from a machine; `detect_message_end` also waits for the greeting to finish, so it answers later. The verdict comes as ElevenLabs's `answering_machine_detection` webhook event, which has to be turned on in the workspace or agent webhook settings; it is not part of the conversation. Twilio bills for it separately. Twilio numbers only; leave empty for no check.

outputs.name: conversationId
outputs.description: The conversation's id: what Agent: Get Conversation takes.

outputs.name: callSid
outputs.description: The call's id at Twilio or Exotel (its CallSid), on a call from one of their numbers.

outputs.name: sipCallId
outputs.description: The call's SIP id, on a call from a SIP trunk number.

then.message: ElevenLabsAgentCall '{id}' has a `toNumber` that is not in E.164 form. Write it as + then the country code and number, with no spaces (+15551234567).
